diagnosis: The SecurityIncidentPolicy#show? method checks record.published? without verifying whether the incident is under active non-disclosure embargo. Any registered tenant user can read zero-day vulnerability exploit POCs and unpatched infrastructure targets.

corrected_code:
class SecurityIncidentPolicy < ApplicationPolicy
  def show?
    return false unless user.present?
    return true if user.platform_secops_admin?
    return true if record.organization_id == user.organization_id
    record.published? && record.embargo_lifted_at&.past?
  end
end

class Security::IncidentsController < ApplicationController
  def show
    @incident = SecurityIncident.find(params[:id])
    authorize @incident

    render json: {
      title: @incident.title,
      cve_id: @incident.cve_id,
      exploit_poc: @incident.exploit_poc,
      affected_assets: @incident.affected_hosts
    }
  end
end
